usageNotes: Use this to check whether a specific Ceph OSD flag is currently set on the cluster before deciding whether to enable or clear it. Requires Sys.Audit on the root path and a running Ceph cluster; the call returns a single boolean (true = flag is active). Commonly called before maintenance windows to confirm flags like 'noout' or 'nobackfill' are set or cleared as expected.

examples.summary: Check if the noout flag is currently enabled

tips: A 'true' response means the flag is active and OSD behavior is modified — e.g., 'noout' prevents OSDs from being marked out during downtime.
This is a read-only companion to set_cluster_ceph_flags_flag; pair them to verify flag state before and after a change.
All valid flag values are enumerated in the spec; any other string will return a 400 error.
